name: KDD
note: Kuwait-HQ'd dairy manufacturer (est. 1962) that also runs a genuine dedicated retail arm: live eshop.kddc.com (100+ SKUs, KWD cart) plus the DUKKAN branded convenience-store chain across Kuwait and Gate-Shop parlors. The branded store network distinguishes it from the Radwa manufacturer-only-D2C fail; corrected Gate 2 hybrid holds.

name: Starlink Qatar
note: Qatar-HQ'd (Ooredoo Group); live transactional store at starlink.qa in QAR with 14+ electronics categories and hundreds of SKUs, plus 17+ physical stores. Approved consumer-electronics category; geography and scale independently solid.

name: United Matbouli Group
note: Saudi-HQ'd (Jeddah, est. 1952); independently confirmed 9 showrooms + 10 branches with explicit B2C retailing as the largest consumer-electronics/appliance retailer in KSA. Substantial dedicated retail alongside Samsung distribution (Lazurde pattern); site was bot-blocked but the retail footprint is independently verified.

name: NTC "Najd Telecom Company"
note: Saudi-HQ'd (Riyadh, est. 2000); 24 physical retail stores plus an online store with Tabby/Tamara BNPL, selling broad mobile/electronics (approved). Substantial retail arm alongside its distribution business; geography and store count confirmed independently.

name: Dar Al Hadaya
note: Genuine established (1969) Saudi home-accessories company, but its online store (al-hadaya.com) could not be confirmed transactional or at scale (repeated WAF 429s; the cited WooCommerce category URL now returns 404), and the firm is described primarily as a furniture designer/manufacturer. Retail identity real but Gate 4/5a e-commerce unverified; prior flip rested on identity alone.

name: foamco.sa
note: Saudi foam/furniture manufacturer trading live at foamco.com.sa; independently re-confirmed broad home-furniture catalog (15+ categories including sofas, beds, dining, tables, lighting, decor; hundreds of SKUs) with SAR cart, made in Saudi Arabia. Broad furniture (not mattress-only); manufacturer plus substantial dedicated retail.

name: GUTHMI Group
note: Jeddah-HQ'd with 20 KSA retail stores and a real WooCommerce store, but the catalog is exclusively upholstery and curtain (home-furnishing) fabrics, a narrow low-repeat line that patterns with the Gate 3 flooring/carpet fail rather than the high-frequency garment-making fabric Gate 3 actually approves. The prior 'fabric/textile is an explicit Gate 3 pass' overstated the rule; category fit is genuinely doubtful.

name: 4Sale International Co.
note: Kuwait's flagship classifieds marketplace, Kuwait-operated; 2.5M+ app downloads independently verified (AppBrain/Play). Gate 5b app-rescue clearly met, overriding category; operating-entity geography is Kuwait.

name: IIPH - International Islamic Publishing House
note: Riyadh/Saudi-HQ'd (+966) publisher running a live transactional consumer bookstore (confirmed cart/checkout, 18+ categories, hundreds of titles, international shipping). Books are an approved category and the D2C store is real and at scale.

name: Takween Bookstore & Publishing House
note: Kuwait-HQ'd (site explicitly states 'based in Kuwait') consumer bookstore/publisher with a live transactional store (cart/checkout, KWD, 40+ categories, 150+ titles across novels/philosophy/children's/comics). Approved books category; genuine broad-interest consumer bookstore.

name: صحصح | Sahseh
note: Coupon/cashback aggregator with 1M+ installs (Gate 5b app path nominally met), but the hard geography gate is not solidly confirmed: strong UAE signals (com.uae.coupons package, Apple /ae/ developer registration, UAE lead-directory listing) coexist with the company's own 'first Saudi app'/SAR-primary self-branding and no independently-verifiable Saudi HQ address. Genuine Gate 1 doubt.

name: Bahamdoon Trading Company
note: Saudi Salla store, but it reads as office/business-supply oriented (office furniture, waiting-room chairs, office tools, computer supplies) serving office buyers, and neither a 50+ SKU scale nor a working SAR cart could be confirmed across two fetches. Closer to office-supply trading than a confirmed substantial consumer-retail operation.

name: AL-ASFOUR FURNITURE Co. Ltd.
note: Saudi-HQ'd (Safwa, Eastern Province, est. 1968); independently confirmed 3 large multi-floor furniture showrooms (3,500sqm Safwa HQ, 2,500sqm Khobar, Dammam) selling broad home/office furniture, carpets and accessories to consumers, plus a live Salla store (transactional platform). Manufacturer + substantial dedicated retail; broad furniture. Note the .com.sa is a dead server directory; the active store is the Salla site alasfour.sa.

name: AL Nasaem Cosmetics Company LLC
note: Kuwait-HQ'd (Salmiya, est. 1988) cosmetics/beauty retailer with a live online store (many product pages) and 8+ physical stores (Salmiya, Avenue Mall, Gate Mall, and others). Cosmetics is an approved category and the multi-store consumer retail is substantial; the prior 'building_materials' tag was a clear misclassification.
